create_nca_transformer: create a NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis transformer to learn a supervised linear transformation for improving k-nearest neighbors classification
fit_nca_model: fit a NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis model on training data to learn an optimal metric space for stochastic nearest neighbors
transform_data_with_nca: transform data using a fitted NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis model to project samples into the learned metric space
initialize_nca_with_pca: initialize a NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis transformer with PCA components for dimensionality reduction before optimization
configure_nca_optimizer: configure a NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis model with custom max iterations, tolerance, and random state for reproducible metric learning
